system.description:
A wizard can walk in the guise of any man. A mage may alter the appearance of his face with this simple illusion. The spell forces others to make an Observation test to recognize the mage. The obstacle is 1 plus the margin of success.

Obstacle: 3^. Actions: 4.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Caster | Element: Heaven | Impetus: Control | Duration: Sustained | Resource Points: 12

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 216
